domains.name: code-changes
domains.scope: Python files, Streamlit components, documentation. Agents may freely modify within the scope of their role.

domains.name: documentation
domains.scope: README, docstrings, inline comments, agent-facing docs.

domains.name: data-pipeline-execution
domains.scope: Running the existing ingestion and processing pipeline on new quarterly data when performance metrics hold or improve.
conditions: Forward-validation shows equal or better performance than previous quarter

domains.name: model-retraining
domains.scope: Retrain model on all existing data including new quarterly data and deploy.
conditions: Forward-validation metrics meet or exceed thresholds (MAPE <= 3.5%, R² >= 0.98)
No changes to feature engineering or model design

domains.name: dependency-additions
domains.scope: Any new pip dependency or version change to requirements.txt. Propose and wait for owner approval.

domains.name: financial-calculation-engine
domains.scope: Any code that computes appreciation, projections, price predictions, or scoring. Changes must be discussed with owner before implementation.

domains.name: protected-patterns
domains.scope: Hardcoded sanity caps, price bounds, projection caps, and performance thresholds. Only modifiable with explicit owner approval after agent flags a concern.
conditions: Agent may flag a concern or recommendation
Must receive explicit owner approval before any modification

domains.name: credentials
domains.scope: .env files, API keys, secrets, any credential or authentication material. Never read, write, log, or expose.

domains.name: feature-engineering
domains.scope: Any changes to feature extraction, feature selection, or feature transformation logic. Discuss with owner before implementing.

domains.name: model-architecture
domains.scope: Any changes to model type, hyperparameter search strategy, or ensemble design. Discuss with owner before implementing.

domains.name: testing-scaffold
domains.scope: QA agent has authority to build and maintain the testing scaffold, test suites, and linting configuration.

global_rules.reason: Credentials. No agent may read, write, or reference.
Credentials. No agent may read, write, or reference.

required_checks.name: tests-pass
required_checks.description: All tests must pass. Zero failures.

quality_gate.enforcement: All code changes must pass the quality gate before commit. QA agent is the final checkpoint and sole authority on whether the gate is met.

escalation.default: When in doubt, ask the owner (Cleburn).

triggers.condition: Forward-validation shows degraded performance (MAPE > 3.5% or R² < 0.98)
triggers.action: Analyst investigates root cause, considers solutions, then discusses with owner before implementing any fix.

triggers.condition: Proposed change to feature engineering or model design
triggers.action: Discuss with owner. No implementation without explicit approval.

triggers.condition: Proposed change to any protected pattern (sanity caps, price bounds, projection logic, performance thresholds)
triggers.action: Flag the concern with rationale to owner. No modification without explicit approval.
Propose with justification. Wait for owner approval.

triggers.condition: Uncertainty about scope, intent, or correctness

commit_authority.policy: Only the QA agent may commit and push to the repository. All other agents produce work products that QA reviews, tests, and gates before committing.

quarterly_cycle.description: Owner drops new Zillow ZHVI files into ~/Downloads/ quarterly. The Data Engineer ingests, the Analyst validates, and QA gates deployment.
steps: Owner drops new ZHVI files in ~/Downloads/
Data Engineer ingests files into data/raw/, runs process_data.py, regenerates predictions in data/processed/
Analyst runs forward-validation against new data
If metrics hold or improve: Analyst retrains model on all data including new quarter, produces updated predictions
If metrics degrade: Analyst investigates, proposes fix, escalates to owner before implementing
QA runs full test suite and lint, reviews all changes
QA commits and pushes if quality gate passes
